text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was observing Symboli 
Rudolf's independent training session. Her 
cornering technique was truly 
magnificent...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: *Haa*, *haa*...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, aren't you the one who came to ask 
about my pose the other day...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How did you find it? My running, that is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. If it served as any reference, 
I am—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Kaicho-saaan! There's something I wanna 
ask you~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm, could it be you also wish to ask about 
that pose? If that is the case—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Pose...? Fight on! The pose isn't what I 
wanted to ask about!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, how can I run the 
corners just like you, Kaicho-san?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see, running advice, is it? Then let 
us talk over there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The key to taking corners well is to 
always be mindful of optimal positioning.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
On corners, the centrifugal force tends to 
push your momentum outward. As a 
countermeasure, engaging your inner core 
muscles—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Are complicated explanations not 
your forte?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, I might be a tiny bit bad with 
them~...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, the fault is mine. I tend to lapse 
into overly academic terms no matter whom 
I address.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you know! It's true that I really, 
really want to try running fast!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I could take corners just like 
Kaicho-san, it looks like it'd be 
super-duper fun!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... For that, you have my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Eh, gratitude? Why?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone possesses their own aspirations. 
"Number One in Japan," "The Triple Crown." 
"Running happily" is every bit as 
magnificent a goal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Whatever it may be, if someone harbors 
even the slightest desire to reach their 
goal, I wish to lend them my strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For that is the very ideal I strive toward 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mnnn~, mnnngh~!? Hard words are too 
confusing for me~...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Indeed. Let us set the difficult 
talk aside. Still, how best should I 
instruct her...
choice_data_list: Why not teach her one step at a time?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm, rather than trying to teach everything 
as a whole, break it down into concise 
points to foster understanding.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. An excellent idea. Then first...
choice_data_list: Tips for cornering in a pack

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. That is the ideal starting point.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? If you wish to run fast 
through corners, there are only two key 
things to keep in mind.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, uh-huh...! Gambare!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
First, keep your head parallel to the 
ground.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Second, ensure your body's central axis 
does not sway or lose its balance.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Pair-o-lull and axes...?
choice_data_list: It doesn't seem to be clicking with her.
It doesn't seem to be clicking.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I see. Explaining things simply 
proves unexpectedly arduous.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well! So be it. I shall not give up 
on explaining until you fully comprehend!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Symboli Rudolf patiently 
repeated her explanations, ultimately 
succeeding in helping her understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Clusters form quite frequently. 
That is certainly an essential lesson to 
impart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When navigating a corner amid a pack, 
there are only two vital points.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
First, avoid boxing yourself into cramped 
spaces. You may find yourself unable to 
take your intended trajectory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Second is observation. The pack tends to 
disperse around the corner's exit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You need the observational acuity not to 
miss that opening. Did you manage to grasp 
that?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... so basically, as long as I run 
fast, it's all good, right!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, when you boil it down, yes, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Thanks for teaching me all kinds of 
stuff! See ya later, President!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do my best so I can run around 
corners super fast~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Cramming it all in at once won't do 
much good, I suppose. As they say, a 
journey of a thousand miles begins with a 
single step.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Still, to 'run happily', is it...? A 
wonderful goal, perfectly fitting for her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I truly hope she sees it through to 
fruition.
